newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares seen mixed but strengthening.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares seen mixed but strengthening.

text.p: The outlook for Singapore shares was likely to be mixed on Monday, but the underlying trend was strengthing, dealers said.
"The market needs a boost, hopefully the gains of last week can be repeated," a dealer with a local brokerage said.
On Friday the Straits Times Industrials Index ended almost unchanged, off 0.32 point at 1,980.96 after a week of good gains on the back of rises on Wall Street.
Breaking the key 2,000 resistance level could be a possibility if the market can build enough momentum, dealers said.
Small cap and electronics stocks were expected to provide the main areas of interest, the dealers said.
